reports.title: House price index (HPI)
reports.description: Eurostat's quarterly house price index for the EU, the euro area and each Member State, published as a quarterly news release and the 'House price and sales index' (prc_hpi_inx) data set, compiled from the national HPIs NSIs transmit under Regulation (EU) 2016/792. Eurostat's own reference metadata names 2016/792 as the basic act and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1470 as the specifications. Minted 2026-10-17 (housing lane 0a step 4).

reports.title: New Housing Price Index (NHPI)
reports.description: Statistics Canada's monthly index of contractors' selling prices for new single, semi-detached and row houses, with the same detailed specifications over time, in 27 census metropolitan areas (December 2016 = 100). Its weights come from CMHC's Market Absorption Survey. It feeds the CPI's homeowners' replacement-cost and mortgage-interest components, and the national accounts use it to deflate the housing stock. The url is StatCan's survey description (IMDB) page, not an edition page. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: MLS® Home Price Index (HPI)
reports.description: CREA's monthly benchmark resale home price index, built from MLS® System sales. Since the March 2022 CPI it has been Statistics Canada's resale-house source in the CPI mortgage-interest model, replacing StatCan's Residential Property Price Index. It is also the BIS selected series for Canada from Q1 2022. Commercial, so a terminal sink. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Teranet-National Bank House Price Index
reports.publisher: Teranet and National Bank of Canada
reports.description: A monthly repeat-sales house price index for Canadian metropolitan areas, built from property records in land registries, developed by Teranet with National Bank of Canada. Named by Statistics Canada's CPI Reference Paper as a source of dwelling price data. Commercial. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Market Absorption Survey
reports.description: CMHC's monthly survey of newly completed homeowner and condominium units in Census Metropolitan Areas of 100,000 or more, enumerated until fully sold, with sales prices collected where possible. It is carried out with the Starts and Completions Survey, and the two share one methodology page, which is this node's url. Its sales values weight Statistics Canada's NHPI. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Starts and Completions Survey
reports.description: CMHC's monthly count of housing starts and completions: site visits confirming new permanent, year-round dwelling units reaching set construction stages, monthly in larger centres and quarterly or sampled in smaller ones. It is released monthly as CMHC's housing starts news release; the url is the September 2026 release. No edge yet: the documents read on 2026-10-17 name no statistic built on it by title. Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: FHFA House Price Index
reports.description: FHFA's house price indexes: a weighted, repeat-sales measure of single-family home values from the mid-1970s, for the nation, census divisions, states, more than 400 cities, counties, ZIP codes and tracts. Monthly and quarterly; the quarterly 'expanded-data' index sets the annual conforming loan limit. Minted 2026-10-17.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly purchase-only indexes plus a quarterly report; 12 counts the monthly releases.

reports.title: Conforming Loan Limit Values
reports.description: FHFA's annual announcement of the maximum loan sizes Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac may acquire, by county. Under HERA the baseline limit moves each year with the average U.S. home price, read off the FHFA HPI, and the high-cost ceiling is 150 percent of the baseline. It acts on the mortgage market directly. The url is the 2026 edition (announced November 2025). Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (CPS/HVS)
reports.description: The Census Bureau's quarterly rental and homeowner vacancy rates and homeownership rate. The url is the current quarterly press release (second quarter 2026, released 28 July 2026). part_of `cps-current-population-survey` (Thomas, 2026-10-17): the HVS is collected within the CPS, not drawn from it. Evidence: the release's own source line reads "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey/Housing Vacancy Survey, July 28, 2026", and the Q2 2026 source-and-accuracy document (census.gov/housing/hvs/files/qtr226/source_26q2.pdf) is headed "CURRENT POPULATION SURVEY/HOUSING VACANCY SURVEY (CPS/HVS) CHANGES". Both were read live on 2026-10-17. Being a part, it takes no dependency edge to the CPS (rule 12). Minted 2026-10-17.

reports.title: Residential Property Price Index and New Tenant Rent Index
reports.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT)
reports.description: The CBRT's monthly report on Turkish housing prices and rents, from its Data Governance and Statistics Department. It carries the Residential Property Price Index (RPPI) with new- and existing-dwelling sub-indices, the New Tenant Rent Index, and unit prices and rents, for the country and NUTS regions, base 2023. The indices are hedonic, built from the valuation reports appraisal companies prepare when banks approve housing loans, weighted by average dwelling values and TURKSTAT household numbers. The url is the CBRT's rolling link to the latest report (September 2026 when read on 2026-10-18). Minted 2026-10-18 (housing lane 0a, the Türkiye lead from step 2).
